groups.defect: The Javadoc for the void methods requireView() (lines 95-98) and requireViewClientScopes() (lines 100-103) says 'Returns {@code true} if ...'. These methods actually throw ForbiddenException when the matching can* check returns false. The text should read 'Throws ForbiddenException if ... returns {@code false}', like the other require* methods.

answer.reasoning: All three suggestions belong in one group. s_a3224d7a covers both wrong Javadocs: requireView() and requireViewClientScopes(). s_cff36f10 covers only requireView() (lines 95-98), and s_c29b13de covers only requireViewClientScopes() (lines 100-103). Each single-method suggestion overlaps the combined one, so the chain joins all three. The judges agree on this grouping and disagree only on the kind. I chose same_location: the two Javadoc blocks sit next to each other in the same file, inside one range (95-103), and the rules prefer same_location for overlapping groups. needsUnifiedComment is true because the group covers two separate Javadoc blocks, and each needs its own edit.
